title: fabrikant project spec
description: Machine-readable schema for fabrikant project specs (*.fabrikant.yaml / *.fabrikant.json). Single source of truth for the spec format: validation (src/fabrikant/specschema.py) and the generated reference (docs/spec-reference.md, scripts/generate-spec-reference.py) both derive from this file. The schema is applied to the EXPANDED spec (after vars/template/relay expansion, see src/fabrikant/specs.py): `use:`/`with:`/`insert:` loops are already inlined, so the template keys on `loop` document the pre-expansion syntax only. Structural checks (types, enums, required fields, ranges) live here; semantic checks (backend registry, cron-vs-retry intervals, alert-route cycles, template parameters, reserved vars) stay in the Python validation in src/fabrikant/specs.py.

name.description: Project name. Defaults to the file name without suffix. Must not contain '::' (lock-key separator).

root.description: Path of the project root the loops operate on (~ and env vars are expanded). Required for validation; defaults to the repo root for specs in .fabrikant/fabrikant.yaml.

env.description: Extra run-context variables (string values) available as {name} in all steps.

max_parallel.description: Maximum parallel runs of this project (integer >= 1, default 3, ADR 0028).

github.description: GitHub repo as owner/name. Default repo for on_issue/on_pr triggers, issue/pr steps and alerts.

hosting.description: Code-hosting provider name, e.g. github, gitlab, or a registered third-party provider. Inferred from the repo host if omitted.

repo.description: Git repo of the project: every run gets a worktree detached on origin/<branch> (ADR 0028).

branch.description: Base branch the run worktrees are created from.

subpath.description: Subdirectory inside the repo the loops operate on (default: repo root).

github_env_file.description: Absolute path to a KEY=VALUE file with GitHub tokens (GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_REVIEWER_TOKEN).

commit_via.description: How commits are made: local `git` (default) or signed commits via the GitHub API (ADR 0010 amendment).

protected.description: Branch names the loops must not touch (legacy, informational — the engine does not enforce it).

notify.description: Alert channels for run events (run_failed, run_exhausted, run_passed).

github_issue.description: Open a GitHub issue on run_failed/run_exhausted (default false).

issue_labels.description: Labels for the alert issue (default: fabrikant).

events.description: Events to notify on (default: run_failed, run_exhausted).

extra_context.description: Project-level prompt context sources for LLM steps (ADR 0008). Step-level extra_context supplements these.

vars.description: Spec-level variables substituted as {name} in all strings (ADR 0047). Keys must be identifiers and must not shadow reserved runtime variables (project, root, issue_number, ...).

loops.description: Loop name -> loop definition. At least one loop is required.

^x-.description: Extension key (e.g. YAML anchor definitions like x-context, x-shared-steps). Ignored by the engine; not part of the spec format. Unknown keys are accepted everywhere (the schema never rejects what the Python validation accepts); `x-` is the documented convention for them.

context_source.description: One prompt context source (extra_context entry): exactly one of file/cmd/value (ADR 0008). Untrusted by default; trusted: true only for repo-owned files and tool output.

name.description: Variable name of the context block.

file.description: File path relative to the step workdir (must not escape it).

cmd.description: Shell command (sh -c) in the step workdir; only stdout counts.

trusted.description: true = content is instruction; default false = content is marked as data (prompt-injection protection).

numeric.description: A number, or a numeric string (`vars:` substitution yields strings). Range/integer checks are enforced by the Python validation.

retry.description: Retry policy for failed runs (ADR 0036). max: 0 disables retry. Loop-level retry overrides the project-level block.

max.description: Number of ADDITIONAL attempts after the first run (integer >= 0, default 3).

backoff.description: Wait before attempt 1..n; the last value applies to all further attempts (default 5m, 30m, 2h).

on.description: Failure kinds (ADR 0035) that may be retried (default: interrupted, transient).

relay.description: Relay tasks (ADR 0037): long-running work as a chain of short audited sessions. Generates the loops relay-dispatch, relay-session and relay-audit.

repo.description: GitHub repo as owner/name (default: project-level github:).

allowed.description: GitHub logins allowed to file relay tasks (briefs are agent instructions).

bot_login.description: Pinned bot identity for status comments (required).

label.description: Issue label marking relay tasks (default: relay task).

dispatch.description: Cron expression of the dispatcher loop (default */15 * * * *).

max_session_minutes.description: Session length cap from the brief (integer >= 1, default 35).

audit_timeout.description: Audit agent timeout in seconds (integer >= 1, default 1200).

trail_archive.description: Where the session trail is archived before the branch goes (ADR 0037).

type.description: Archive target (s3 is planned, not implemented).

loop.description: A loop: a chain of steps started by triggers. Concrete loops need steps; template loops (pre-expansion) use use:/with:/insert: instead (ADR 0047).

steps.description: Ordered step chain. Every step stops the run on failure by default.

triggers.description: What starts the loop (manual, cron, on_file, on_issue, on_pr, on_webhook, on_alert, on_slack).

worktree.description: false = no git worktree, empty scratch dir per run (ADR 0020); only allowed without worktree-requiring steps (git, pr, agent, review, pr_review).

tier.description: Risk tier as spec data (1 = lowest, 4 = highest); mapped to gates/approvals by a single mapping function.

exclusive_group.description: Loops with the same group never run at the same time for the same issue/PR (e.g. review-pr + pr-reply). A trigger run blocked this way is dropped like one over max_parallel (with reconcile it fires again on the next poll); queued manual runs and resumes wait. Like max_parallel and the per-loop dedup, the check for running runs is per fabrikant process (one process per project, ADR 0028); a run paused for approval holds its issue/PR across processes.

use.description: Template loop (pre-expansion): name of a <name>.loop.yaml template (ADR 0047). Expanded before validation.

with.description: Template loop (pre-expansion): parameter values for the template.

insert.description: Template loop (pre-expansion): extra steps inserted after named template steps. Cannot be combined with own steps.

after.description: Name of the template step to insert after.

step.description: One step of a loop. `type` selects the step kind; the per-type fields are listed under that type. Common fields (name, gate, approval, ...) apply to all types.

type.description: Step kind: a built-in (shell, git, pr, agent, report, http, llm, notify, state, verify, review, pr_review, pr_merge, issue, human_gate, alert_route, escalation) or a plugin registered via the `fabrikant.steps` entry point (ADR 0069); membership is checked at load time.

name.description: Step name (run log, insert anchors, reports).

gate.description: false = a failure of this step does NOT stop the run (default true).

approval.description: true = pause the run for human approval before this step (ADR 0015).

approval_when.description: Conditional approval (ADR 0017): mapping variable -> value or list of values; pauses only when the variable matches. Not combinable with approval: true.

approval_reason.description: Template for the approval request text ({variables} allowed).

failure_kind.description: Failure class (ADR 0035) for non-zero exit codes; shell steps only.

extra_context.description: Step-level prompt context sources for LLM steps (ADR 0008); false disables the project-level context for this step.

cmd.description: shell: command (sh -c in the workdir; {variables} substituted).

timeout.description: Step timeout in seconds (>= 0; shell, http, llm, agent).

env.description: shell: extra environment variables for the command.

commit.description: git: commit the worktree changes (add = pathspecs, message = commit message).

push.description: git: push the branch after commit.

protected.description: git/pr_review: refuse to touch protected branches.

repo.description: pr/pr_review/pr_merge/issue/human_gate/escalation: GitHub repo as owner/name (default: project-level github:).

title.description: pr: PR title. issue (create/edit): issue title. Templates allowed.

body.description: pr: PR body. issue (create/edit): issue body. Templates allowed.

head.description: pr: head branch (default: the run branch).

base.description: pr: base branch (default: project base branch).

labels.description: pr/issue: labels to set (list or comma-separated string).

prompt.description: agent/llm: prompt text (template allowed). agent: exactly one of prompt/prompt_file.

prompt_file.description: agent/review: prompt file path (relative to the project root).

backend.description: agent/review/pr_review: agent backend name (default: installation default; must be a known backend).

model.description: agent/llm/review/pr_review: model name. review/pr_review: required (must differ from the builder model, ADR 0003).

connection.description: agent: named connection (ADR 0052) providing the backend credentials; unknown names are a warning, not an error (host state).

tools.description: agent (claude_code, copilot): restrict the available tools. claude_code: hard limit on the built-ins that exist, passed to --tools (e.g. [Read, Grep, Edit]; MCP tools unaffected); copilot: --allow-tool value (default: all tools).

allowed_tools.description: agent (claude_code): pre-approval rules passed to --allowedTools (e.g. Edit(/.fabrikant-session/review/review.json)); the CLI then runs in dontAsk mode and denies calls that would prompt. Not an allowlist: calls needing no approval (reads, read-only Bash) and approvals from settings.json files still run; use tools for a hard limit. Default: acceptEdits + Bash.

billing.description: llm/agent: billing kind (api = real cost, subscription = list-price equivalent only, unknown); overrides backend auto-detection.

github_identity.description: agent: GitHub identity (token) the agent uses for pushes/PRs.

workdir.description: agent: working directory inside the worktree.

permissions.description: agent: tool permissions for the session.

retries.description: agent: number of session restarts after the first attempt (integer >= 0, default 2).

stale_after.description: agent: seconds without progress before the session counts as stale (>= 0, default 900).

text.description: report: report text (template allowed); logged, or written with write:.

write.description: report: file path (inside the project root) to write the report to.

method.description: http: HTTP method (default GET); pr_merge: squash | merge | rebase (default squash).

emit.description: http: response parts to store as variables (variable -> body|status). issue: name of the variable to store the result in (create: issue number, list: issue lines; default issue_number / issues).

schema.description: llm: JSON schema the response must match.

untrusted.description: llm: variable names whose values are marked as untrusted data in the prompt (prompt-injection protection, Leitprinzip 7).

action.description: state: get|set|add on the state file. issue: create|edit|label|close|list|block. (Other step types ignore the field; the per-type enum is enforced below.)

value.description: state: value to set/add (any JSON type).

file.description: state: state file path (default: project state dir).

checks.description: verify: check-list of steps that must all pass (issue #117).

target.description: review: review target (default: the worktree diff).

max_rounds.description: pr_review: max review/fix rounds (integer >= 0; 0 = review only, ADR 0039).

max_findings.description: pr_review: max findings per round (integer >= 1, ADR 0039).

fix_backend.description: pr_review: backend for the fix rounds.

fix_model.description: pr_review: model for the fix rounds.

fix_variant.description: pr_review: backend variant for the fix rounds.

fix_timeout.description: pr_review: fix agent timeout in seconds (integer >= 1).

fix_check_timeout.description: pr_review: fix check timeout in seconds (integer >= 1).

fix_checks.description: pr_review: shell commands that must pass after a fix round.

fix_commit.description: pr_review: commit fix rounds to the PR branch.

update_branch.description: pr_merge: update the branch before merging.

number.description: issue: issue number (for edit/label/close/block; default: the triggering issue).

inherit_labels.description: issue (create): whitelist of labels inherited from the referenced issue (e.g. priority).

limit.description: issue: max items for list (integer >= 1, default 100).

append.description: issue (edit): true = append the body to the existing one instead of replacing it.

unless_contains.description: issue (edit + append): skip when the current body already contains this marker (idempotency).

state_reason.description: issue (close): close reason (completed | not_planned | duplicate; templates allowed, default: completed).

duplicate_of.description: issue (close): close as duplicate of #N and re-hang blocker relations onto #N (ADR 0031).

blocked_by.description: issue (block): issue references like '#12, #14' that block this issue (max 5, ADR 0031).

prerequisite.description: issue (block): newly created prerequisite issue reference, always added to the blockers.

only_if.description: issue: condition mapping variable -> value or list of values; the step is a no-op when any variable is missing or has none of the values (AND over variables, OR over values).

skip_if_empty.description: issue: variable name(s); the step is a no-op when all of them are empty.

max_files.description: human_gate: diff heuristic — more changed files makes the gate critical (integer >= 1, default 40).

max_lines.description: human_gate: diff heuristic — more +/- lines makes the gate critical (integer >= 1, default 1500).

keywords.description: human_gate: keywords that make the gate critical (default: GDPR/data-loss/migration terms).

adr_paths.description: human_gate: paths whose touch always makes the gate critical (default: docs/adr).

llm.description: human_gate: use an LLM critique in addition to the heuristics.

routes.description: alert_route: alert category -> target loop (or none) (ADR 0045). Required; targets must be loops of this project and the route graph must be acyclic.

fallback.description: alert_route: target loop for unknown categories.

item.description: escalation: the item to escalate (issue/PR reference, template allowed).

label.description: escalation: label to apply (default: needs human, ADR 0059).

grant_rounds.description: escalation: fix rounds granted on approval (integer >= 0).

trigger.description: What starts a loop. `type` selects the trigger kind; the per-type fields are listed under that type.

on_start.description: cron: fire once when the scheduler starts (default false).

glob.description: on_file: glob pattern relative to the project root (default *).

debounce.description: on_file: seconds the newest mtime must be stable before firing (>= 0, default 60).

repo.description: on_issue/on_pr: GitHub repo as owner/name (default: project-level github:; one of the two is required).

priority_labels.description: on_issue: labels used to sort candidates (first match wins, ADR 0021).

exclude_labels.description: on_issue/on_pr: issues/PRs with any of these labels do not start the loop (ADR 0059).

reconcile.description: on_issue: fire for every matching open issue without a run record (ADR 0014). on_pr: true/false or 'head' (per head SHA, ADR 0023).

skip_blocked.description: on_issue with reconcile: true: skip issues with open 'blocked by' dependencies (ADR 0031).

max_per_poll.description: on_issue with reconcile: max runs started per poll (integer >= 1).

states.description: on_pr: PR states to react to (default: open).

secret_env.description: on_webhook/on_alert: name of the environment variable holding the shared HMAC secret (required).

map.description: on_webhook: variable -> JSON path in the payload.

replay_protection.description: on_webhook: require timestamp + nonce in the signature (replay protection, issue #60).

token_env.description: on_slack: name of the environment variable holding the bot token (required; the token itself never goes into the spec).

channels.description: on_slack: non-empty whitelist of channel IDs like C0123ABC (required).

pattern.description: on_slack: regex the alert text must match.

max_pages.description: on_slack: history pages per channel and poll (integer >= 1, default 20).

max_alert_chars.description: on_slack: alert_text is truncated beyond this (integer >= 1, default 4000).
